input_description: Completed isolated paint-bands-03 candidate; retains the earlier parts005/006 improvement

strategy: Translate each existing lower end to the unchanged floor top, including the entire lower 6mm bevel profile of the aluminum posts. Preserve upper ends, XY coordinates, topology, material definitions, identity and all other objects.
limits: A simplified closure repair using existing parts, not an as-built reconstruction of sill profiles or seals.
The existing floor elevation and circular plan remain inherited estimates, not surveyed dimensions.
The separate 300mm floor-to-lower-white-shell gap and upper glass-to-roof clearance are outside this change.
No city integration, registry change, tree change, main-deck window-slope change or full self-intersection certification.
